description.value: Tacofino is a beloved West Coast casual Mexican restaurant brand that originated as a food truck in Tofino and has grown into a multi-location chain across BC. The Victoria Downtown location on Pandora Avenue brings the same beach-inspired tacos and burritos to the heart of the city. It is a convenient, quick-service stop for cyclists moving through downtown Victoria.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (38 spaces) at 40m; wide_stands (16 spaces) at 44m; rack (10 spaces) at 66m; staple (6 spaces) at 70m; rack (10 spaces) at 76m; bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 90m; bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 97m. Total: 84 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's locations page confirms an active 'Victoria Downtown' listing at 760 Pandora Ave Victoria, BC with email victoria@tacofino.com, both matching OSM tags exactly. The site prominently features 'Order for Pickup' for this location, confirming takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, and the OSM tags carry no such information either.
concerns: Phone number (+1 778-406 1787) from OSM could not be verified against the website; the Victoria Downtown listing on tacofino.com does not display a phone number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed open at this address via the brand's own website. A practical food stop for touring cyclists in downtown Victoria.

wow_evidence: originated as a food truck in Tofino and has grown into a multi-location chain across BC
